definitions.explanation: Leaving one's current company to take a job at a different one. Refers to moving between employers, not to a transfer or reassignment within the same company.

examples.japanese: ⟦IT→IT：07809_aitii⟧⟦{企業|きぎょう}→企業：00225_kigyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{転職|てんしょく}した。
examples.english: I changed jobs to an IT company.

examples.japanese: {転職|てんしょく}⟦サイト→サイト：05603_saito⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探|さが}している→探す：00493_sagasu⟧。
examples.english: I'm looking for a job on a job-hunting site.

examples.japanese: {転職|てんしょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{考|かんが}えている→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧。

{転職|てんしょく}⟦{活動|かつどう}→活動：00201_katsudou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{始|はじ}めた→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦なかなか→なかなか：01547_nakanaka⟧⟦{良|よ}い→良い：02350_yoi⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}つからない→見つかる：01173_mitsukaru⟧。
examples.english: I started job hunting, but I can't seem to find a good company.

examples.japanese: {転職|てんしょく}して⟦{給料|きゅうりょう}→給料：01086_kyuuryou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{上|あ}がった→上がる：00615_agaru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{方|ほう}→方：01139_hou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{働|はたら}きやすかった→働く：00503_hataraku⟧。
examples.english: My salary went up after changing jobs, but my previous company was easier to work at.

notes:
{転職|てんしょく} means changing from one company to another. This is different from ⟦{転勤|てんきん}→転勤：04555_tenkin⟧, which is a transfer within the same company.

Distinction:
- {転職|てんしょく}: changing companies
- ⟦{転勤|てんきん}→転勤：04555_tenkin⟧: transferring within the same company

Common expressions:
- {転職|てんしょく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (change jobs)
- {転職|てんしょく}⟦{活動|かつどう}→活動：00201_katsudou⟧ (job hunting activities)
- {転職|てんしょく}⟦サイト→サイト：05603_saito⟧ / {転職|てんしょく}⟦エージェント→エージェント：10752_eejento⟧ (job change website/agency)

Cultural note:
Job-hopping was traditionally viewed negatively in Japan, where lifetime employment was the norm. However, changing jobs has become more common and accepted in recent years.
